themes.name: Frontier Industrial
themes.description: Blue-grey structural steel, copper safety bands and teal instruments. Utility hulls, cargo craft and stations.
themes.shape_language: Square plates, exposed braces, practical chamfers.

themes.name: Aegis Naval
themes.description: Navy armour, restrained gold identification and ice-blue instruments. Military and escort fleets.
themes.shape_language: Long spines, bilateral symmetry, layered angular armour.

themes.name: Helix Research
themes.description: Porcelain panels, dark teal joints and turquoise lights. Research, medical and exploration.
themes.shape_language: Broad clean bows, recessed equipment and orderly module spacing.

themes.name: Corsair Salvage
themes.description: Oxide red, warm ivory patches, dark metal and hot amber signals. Salvage, pirates and heavy industry.
themes.shape_language: Asymmetric wings, patched plates, exposed tanks and clustered engines.

themes.name: Verdant Logistics
themes.description: Olive ceramic armour, sand braces, safety yellow and pale-green instruments. Freight and agricultural fleets.
themes.shape_language: Broad cargo bodies, external pod racks, blunt armoured shoulders.

themes.name: Umbra Syndicate
themes.description: Charcoal-violet plating, silver edges, electric violet and cyan secondary accents. Covert and advanced fleets.
themes.shape_language: Swept asymmetric fins, notched hulls, needle bows and luminous cores.
